page_title: BOU 0-2 LIV | Bournemouth v Liverpool 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Darren England has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+4' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
90+3' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) picks up an injury.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) has come on for Mohamed Salah.
87' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:7.

83' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
80' A substitution has been made. Ryan Christie is replaced by Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth).
76' Andoni Iraola is stunned as referee Darren England shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
75' 0 - 2 Goal! Curtis Jones slips it to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) on the edge of the box and he finds the left side of the net with a great effort. The score is 0:2.
73' There's an opportunity for Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
71' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
70' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the left post.
70' Here comes a substitution. Trent Alexander-Arnold is given a rest as he is replaced by Conor Bradley (Liverpool).
70' The substitution has been made. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) has replaced Cody Gakpo.
69' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
66' Here is a change. David Brooks is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
66' The whistle blows and Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is booked for an infringement.
61' It will be a substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is ready to enter the pitch as Alexis Mac Allister walks off.

60' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
58' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes a short corner kick.
55' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) gets booked for the first time in this match.
54' What was Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
52' Bournemouth fail to score from a corner as Alisson (Liverpool) leaps to collect the ball.

51' He should have scored! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Alisson makes an easy save. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
49' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
48' Bournemouth are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' Darren England blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
41' Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) after a cross from the side.
39' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Bournemouth players look gutted.
38' The Bournemouth players joy may have been justified, because referee Darren England is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
37' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. David Brooks (Bournemouth) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
34' A pass from Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Alisson and the move breaks down.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Kepa Arrizabalaga.
29' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is going to take the penalty!
29' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

29' Play continues despite the shouts by some Liverpool players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Darren England interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
26' Bournemouth are ruled offside.

23' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Kepa Arrizabalaga is alert and denies him with a nice save.
21' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the left post!
20' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

17' Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a brilliant save! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
14' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Alisson (Liverpool).
11' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
9' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
8' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
7' The ball is cleared after Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' David Brooks (Bournemouth) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
2' The resulting set piece from Liverpool is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Alisson.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Darren England was nominated as the referee for this game.
